15 Minutes to the End of the World

name: 15 Minutes to the End of the World
storyline:
We play as Niki, a police woman, who discovers that there are several entities that cursed the world and all its inhabitants, invoking the end of the world in only 15 minutes! After this time lapse, everything will reset until 15 minutes before the world is destroyed.
As Niki, you will need to fight hordes of cute but dangerous monsters and big badass bosses! You have the key to save the world from destruction, and only you have the skills and strength to be able to survive the time-loop as many times as you need.
summary: 15 minutes to the End of the World is a third person shooter inspired in anime and japanese culture, with a story based on the best time-loop Hollywood feature films - with a twist!
